title: CORE DataSink
description: Configuration for a data sink that receives transformed data from a CORE pipeline. The target is chosen by 'connectionType' (frost | postgis); each variant declares exactly the fields the pipeline engine (config-adapter → NiFi) reads. 'element' references, by versioned CORE URN, the DataStructure describing the output row/entity format — Model Forge records it as a datasink-element dependency edge.

FrostDataSink.title: FROST DataSink
FrostDataSink.description: Writes to an OGC SensorThings API / FROST-Server. A passthrough sink may carry no configuration; otherwise it references the mapping's Thing-shaped target structure by URN.

id.description: Versioned CORE URN of this DataSink.

element.description: Versioned CORE URN of the DataStructure describing the Thing-shaped target structure.

PostgisDataSink.title: PostGIS DataSink
PostgisDataSink.description: Writes rows into a PostGIS table.

id.description: Versioned CORE URN of this DataSink.

element.description: Versioned CORE URN of the DataStructure describing the row format written to the table.
